items.name: Frank Laskowski
items.text: David and Amanda are a pleasure to work with. These guys are the real deal. They're great at what they do with a price point that is spot on. I highly recommend them.

items.name: Linda Binnenkade
items.text: If I could give this company more stars I would. They work very hard and we are always pleased with the outcome. Thank you Trimming Edge!

items.name: Robert Brayton
items.text: Excellent clean and efficient work. My lawn always looks better after Trimming Edge completes their work. David and Amanda are kind and caring. They treat it as if it was their own lawn.

items.text: Contracted for Fall cleanup. Came early and did an outstanding job. Highly recommend, friendly and hard working crew.
